why: Tried to refute on all three axes and could not. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM: curl of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works.md gives the sentence word-for-word on line 74, inside the '## What Claude can access' bullet list: '* **[Auto memory](/docs/en/memory#auto-memory).** Learnings Claude saves automatically as you work, like project patterns and your preferences. The first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md, whichever comes first, load at the start of each session.' Read the WHOLE line — the preceding sentence is scene-setting and nothing in it reverses or qualifies the limit. memory.md:384 and sub-agents.md:521 restate the same rule, so the sub-agents.md half of the claim is also verbatim-accurate. (2) CITED FILE: packages/shared/src/agent/memory/memory-store.ts:8 is `export const MEMORY_LOAD_LINE_LIMIT = 200;` and :29-32 is `readMemoryFile(filePath, maxLines = MEMORY_LOAD_LINE_LIMIT)` = `readFileSync(filePath,'utf-8').split(/\r?\n/).slice(0, maxLines)` — a line slice with no byte check. Exactly as claimed. (3) CONSEQUENCE, verified separately from the identifier and in both directions: no byte cap exists anywhere on the memory path. `grep -ran` over packages/ apps/ for 25*1024 / 25600 / 25000 / maxBytes / byteLimit (with -a, so NUL-carrying files are not skipped) returns only unrelated things: a 25_000-token skill-reattach budget, plugin-artifact and execution-receipt truncators, and RULE_PATTERN_EXPANSION_BYTE_LIMIT = 4MB in agent/memory/rule-matching.ts, which is a glob-expansion budget, not a load cap. One layer UP makes the gap larger, not smaller: prompts/system.ts:453-455 skips loadMemoryPromptBlock entirely when `capabilityContextPinned` — which is the live route on every normal send — and the pinned route reads each memory layer through capabilities/materializer.ts:168-184 `readText`, a whole-file `readFileSync` with no cap, whose content base-agent.ts:976-1014 `composePinnedCapabilityContext` pushes verbatim into the block. So on the live path there is not even a 200-line cap; the 200-line `readMemoryFile` survives only in the legacy fallback composer and in the import-scan pass at capabilities/native-sources.ts:427. One layer DOWN rules out the sibling-subsystem trap: capabilities/native-sources.ts:772 does define MAX_NESTED_INSTRUCTION_FILE_BYTES = 10*1024 with real truncation at :875-877, but that applies to lazily-read nested CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md instruction files, a different subsystem, and never to MEMORY.md memory layers. Not one of the nine dated owner decisions in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (seatbelt wildcard, availableModels/isManagedModelAllowed, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries/listSessions — none touch memory sizing). Not a rebrand, gateway or dropped-subscription product difference either. Only imprecision worth noting, and it does not refute: the claim says the overflow lands in 'every session's system prompt', whereas on the Claude backend the pinned block rides the user-message tail and only the legacy composer puts it in the system prompt; and the sub-agents.md path is a different defect (per-agent memory is unimplemented end to end — f089/f148 — so nothing is truncated there because nothing is loaded).
correctedState: There is no 25KB byte cap on auto-memory loading anywhere in the repo, and the live path applies no cap at all. `readMemoryFile` (packages/shared/src/agent/memory/memory-store.ts:29-32) slices to `MEMORY_LOAD_LINE_LIMIT = 200` lines with no byte check, but it is only reached by the LEGACY composer: prompts/system.ts:455 calls `loadMemoryPromptBlock` solely when the capability runtime is NOT pinned. On the live route the MEMORY.md layer is read whole by capabilities/materializer.ts:168-184 `readText` and pushed verbatim into the pinned block by base-agent.ts:976-1014, so neither the 200-line limit nor the 25KB limit is enforced. The only byte cap on any instruction content is MAX_NESTED_INSTRUCTION_FILE_BYTES = 10 * 1024 (capabilities/native-sources.ts:772, truncation at :875-877), which covers lazily-read nested CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md files, not MEMORY.md.
